A run either lens did not mark generic was escalated to three more reviewers (idiom, provenance, skeptic) and signed off only when all three said generic with high confidence. Codex was unavailable until 2026-11-12 (OVERNIGHT-DECISIONS row 40). The owner may revoke any entry.
